title: File Uploads
description: Learn how to handle file uploads in React forms.

data.text: File uploads in React use **uncontrolled components** because file inputs cannot be controlled by React state (their value is read-only).

data.title: File Input
Multiple Files

data.text: For better UX, implement drag and drop file uploads.

data.title: Drag and Drop
File Validation
data.text: Always validate file types and sizes on both client and server. Client validation improves UX, but server validation is essential for security.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use FormData to send files to server
Support multiple files with the multiple attribute
data.takeaway: File uploads require special handling in React.
